identification: Octagonal blue and white porcelain meat platter, pagoda/bridge/figures/geese landscape in a cartouche well with trellis and fish-roe/ruyi border; hard glassy pale-celadon glaze, unglazed recessed foot rim with an orange-brown iron wash across the base. Consistent with Chinese export porcelain of the Qianlong period (c.1750-1790), 'Nanking'-type. About 36 cm per catalogue. Unmarked. A hand-written old inventory label on the rim.
